imageNote: This lesson surveys multiple vendors (Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Chroma, Milvus), so real screenshots from each vendor's own docs were specifically searched for before defaulting to a single example. Pinecone's current docs (create-an-index, manage-indexes guides) and Weaviate's current docs (console-overview, quickstart) were fetched directly and inspected via rendered DOM (curl alone returned no embedded screenshots, confirming these pages are now code/API-sample-first with no console imagery) — both vendors' documentation sites currently ship no embedded real screenshots of their console UI to source honestly. Chroma's docs are code-first by design (it's an embedded library, not primarily a console product). Qdrant's documentation remains screenshot-rich, so its real Cloud console overview page is used here as the one representative 'fully managed' example (confirmed via curl as Content-Type: image/png, exact byte-size match against the official qdrant.tech CDN file, and viewed with the Read tool before captioning) — this is a different screenshot (the cluster Overview tab) than the one already used in Lesson 10 (the Console/REST tab), so there's no repeat image across the two lessons. The vendor comparison itself is conveyed through brand-styled steps slides (an honest, original summary), not a claimed screenshot of products that don't have one available.
